name: core.openwop.workflows.funnels
description: Funnel optimization chains (ADR 0294 / Funnel A, Phase 6) — read-only analysis over the funnels feature nodes: per-step stats in, a grounded optimization proposal out. Proposals only: publishing, step edits, and experiment starts remain human actions in the Funnels page.
author: OpenWOP App

chains.label: Funnel Step Optimization Proposal
chains.description: Reads a funnel's definition and per-step stats, identifies the weakest step (honest about small samples), and produces a grounded optimization proposal: what to change on that step's page, and the 50/50 challenger experiment a human should start in the Funnels page. Read-only — no drafts are written, nothing is published.

goal.description: What the funnel should optimize for.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

config.systemPrompt: You are a conversion-rate specialist. Given a funnel definition and its per-step totals (views, completions, revenue, orders), identify the weakest step for the goal: {{params.goal}}. Ground every claim in the provided numbers; if a step's sample is small, say the data is insufficient rather than over-reading it. Output: (1) the weakest step and why, (2) concrete page changes to test, (3) the 50/50 challenger experiment to start in the Funnels page (a human starts it), (4) what result would confirm or refute the hypothesis. Never invent traffic, revenue, or pages.

proposal.description: The grounded optimization proposal (weakest step, page changes, the experiment a human should start).
